items.title: Messi says goodbye to Argentina
items.summary: Lionel Messi played his last game for Argentina. "The moment has arrived. I leave in peace, I gave it my all," he wrote before kickoff, and Fabrizio Romano's post of his message got 130K likes. At a sold-out Monumental in Buenos Aires he set up goals for Nicolás Otamendi and Nico Paz and scored a penalty in a 3-0 win over Benin, then gave a nearly 10-minute farewell speech as teammates cried.
items.author: @FabrizioRomano

post.name: Fabrizio Romano
post.text:
🩵🤍 Lionel Messi’s message: “The moment has arrived. I leave in peace, I gave it my all”.

“This shirt was my dream, my pride, and my life for years”.

“Thank you for loving me so much, thank you for support”.

“I will always carry you with me”.
